app_context: Data-dense B2B FMCG/Beverage CRM spreadsheet grid view with sticky panes, custom formula columns, and consignment planner
theme: Light mode, Swiss-precision high-contrast B2B aesthetic with #002FA7 (International Klein Blue / Royal Blue) accent, dark slate headers, and soft tonal data hierarchy

hierarchy.table_header: text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-200 select-none

typography.tabular_nums_rule: MUST apply 'tabular-nums' class on EVERY numeric, date, currency, crate quantity, and calculation cell to ensure vertical digit alignment across all rows.

low_stock_flag.cell_style: bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 font-semibold border-l-2 border-rose-500 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-sm inline-block

text_columns.rules: Left-aligned, standard kerning, primary entity bold with secondary metadata (city, territory) in muted subtext

numeric_columns.rules: Right-aligned, tabular-nums font feature, Indian currency / number format (toLocaleString('en-IN')), empty values render as muted em-dash ('—')

date_columns.rules: Left-aligned, tabular-nums, formatted as 'DD MMM YYYY' (e.g. 14 Aug 2024), recency pill overlay on latest_delivery_date

list_columns.header_align: text-right for crates, text-left for dates
list_columns.cell_align: text-right for crates, text-left for dates
list_columns.rules: Stacked micro-lines (leading-tight) with newest value at top featuring recency indicator, historical values in muted slate-500

new_column_definition.label: Account Age (Days)
new_column_definition.calculation: Derived from Date.now() - new Date(onboarded_date || first_delivery_date) in days

default_hidden_columns_spec.implementation_notes: Initialize hidden state with default hidden columns if localStorage is empty, while preserving user preference overrides

table_layout_and_freeze_pane_system.container: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm overflow-auto max-h-[calc(100vh-250px)]

sticky_z_index_hierarchy.corner_header_cell_account_name: sticky top-0 left-0 z-40 bg-[#0b192c] text-white shadow-[inset_-1px_0_0_#334155,inset_0_-1px_0_#1e293b]
sticky_z_index_hierarchy.table_headers: sticky top-0 z-20 bg-[#0b192c] text-slate-100 shadow-[inset_0_-1px_0_#1e293b]

table_layout_and_freeze_pane_system.zebra_striping_pattern: Even rows bg-white, Odd rows bg-slate-50/70, Row Hover bg-[#EDF2FA] with left-accent 2px indicator

editable_cell_ux_guidelines.passive_state: w-full px-2 py-1 -mx-2 rounded hover:bg-[#002FA7]/5 hover:ring-1 hover:ring-[#002FA7]/30 transition-all text-right tabular-nums group cursor-pointer
editable_cell_ux_guidelines.active_editing_state: h-7 w-28 rounded border-[#002FA7] ring-2 ring-[#002FA7]/20 bg-white text-xs font-semibold px-2 text-right shadow-sm
editable_cell_ux_guidelines.save_behavior: Save on Enter and blur, cancel on Escape with instant visual confirmation via sonner toast

pending_consumption_popover_design.badge_style: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-medium bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border border-slate-200
pending_consumption_popover_design.info_icon_button: p-0.5 rounded-full text-slate-400 hover:text-[#002FA7] hover:bg-[#002FA7]/10 transition-colors
pending_consumption_popover_design.popover_content: w-72 bg-white p-3 rounded-md shadow-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-600

consignment_planner_section_specs.wrapper: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm overflow-hidden mt-6
consignment_planner_section_specs.header_bar: flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 px-5 py-3.5 bg-slate-50/80 border-b border-slate-200
consignment_planner_section_specs.truck_card_style: border border-slate-200/80 rounded-md p-3.5 bg-gradient-to-b from-white to-slate-50/50 shadow-xs hover:border-[#002FA7]/40 transition-all
consignment_planner_section_specs.utilization_badge_high: text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-emerald-200/60
consignment_planner_section_specs.utilization_badge_med: text-xs font-semibold text-amber-700 bg-amber-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-amber-200/60

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.framework: React JS with Tailwind CSS and Radix/shadcn UI primitives
strict_rules: DO NOT rewrite to third-party grid library (AG-Grid/Handsontable) - maintain incremental pure HTML table + Tailwind
DO NOT remove or rename any existing data-testid attribute
ALWAYS ensure all table headers and cells have exact matching alignment between <th> and <td>
DO NOT use emojis anywhere in UI, use lucide-react icons exclusively
ALWAYS maintain light theme visual consistency across dialogs, popovers, and tables
Default hidden columns MUST include: 'order_count', 'onboarded_date', 'last_order_sku', and 'account_age_days'
DO NOT use transition: all globally. Use targeted transitions like transition-colors and transition-transform

instructions_to_main_agent: Step 1: In /app/frontend/src/pages/AccountVolumeGrid.js, update BASE_COLUMNS to include '{ key: 'account_age_days', label: 'Account Age (Days)', type: 'number' }' and adjust formula context if needed.
Step 2: Update default hidden state in useState: default to ['order_count', 'onboarded_date', 'last_order_sku', 'account_age_days'] when localStorage is empty.
Step 3: Align all column headers and cells strictly based on column_alignment_and_formatting_rules (numbers text-right, text text-left, dates text-left with tabular-nums).
Step 4: Upgrade table headers to dark slate (#0b192c) with crisp dividers, prominent sort indicators, and elegant column resize handles.
Step 5: Apply crisp zebra striping (white / slate-50/70) and hover row highlight (#EDF2FA) with matching sticky left column background synchronization.
Step 6: Style the frozen summary row with #EAF0FC background, bold #002FA7 text, tabular numbers, and clean border separator.
Step 7: Refine the warehouse stock red flag cell with soft rose badge treatment and recency pills with subtle contemporary palette.
Step 8: Verify all data-testid attributes remain functional and test user interactions.
